steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Zakah is the third Pillar of Islam — Muslims must give 2.5% of their surplus wealth each year to charity. It is not optional; it is a religious duty and a form of worship. Shi'a Muslims also pay khums (20% of surplus income) to their religious leaders. | RS Exam Tips — Zakah and Khums: 1. For Zakah and Khums questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5.
